feature_contract.goal: Keep the full VR gameplay F11 configuration window and its controls readable at Quest3-density XR eye extents while preserving desktop, keyboard/gamepad input, window placement and existing single-image overlay semantics.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only F11 responsive font/control sizing and the existing scrollable tab body, plus its targeted negative regression verifier; do not change world/HUD stereo projection, frame pacing, native desktop font density, saved user settings or unrelated display backends.
trace_stages: Original F11 overlay receives an eye-derived font atlas density and actual D3D9 backbuffer content rectangle, then the responsive budget chooses window-local glyph and control metrics.

OutRunF11ResponsiveFit::Compute now reserves a 480 source-pixel scrollable settings height so high-density VR font glyphs remain readable rather than downscaled to a full 600 source-pixel content page.

The existing ImGui BeginChild tab body scrolls excess settings, and the external ScreenOverlay2D draw remains owned by the existing R84 D3D9 stereo-to-OpenXR per-eye submission without changing menu or desktop fallback.
subcomponents: Correct the F11 responsive height budget for legible XR window glyphs while respecting the actual viewport bounds and retaining the independent font atlas and window-local scale owner.
Exercise Quest3 3440x1440 and smaller source resolutions in the focused numeric/mutation regression, and require the existing scrollable child plus desktop 1x preservation.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: XR font atlas, responsive F11 geometry and scrollable tab body
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: The 3440x1440 Quest3-mirror XR settings tab preserves a near-native dense font scale while the existing ImGui tab body scrolls any controls exceeding viewport height.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Desktop, minimized-size and transient eye-publication fallback
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Desktop F11 retains unity glyph density, finite bounded sizing survives tiny or invalid extents, and previous XR font atlas semantics do not change game HUD/SkyGlow ownership.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: R84 x86 game, R26_SAFE rollback, x64 host, package and policy integration
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: All required GitHub exact-SHA Active Validation, Domain and applicable source-impact gates pass without CI skip; physical Quest3/VDXR appearance remains separately untested.

diagnosis.original_evidence: Source diff at 2a066264 shows F11 height fitting against 600 multiplied by XR density even though ImGui BeginChild tabbody provides independent scrolling; the source 3440x1440 Quest3-mirror numeric case downscaled fonts to about 0.78.
diagnosis.root_cause: Tying glyph scale to the full fixed virtual settings content height shrinks all dense XR glyphs before the tab scrollbar can expose overflowing settings; the 480px control budget preserves window-local glyph size with scrolling.
source_trace: The frame hook computes XR atlas density from published eye extent and enters the external VR F11 overlay while preserving the desktop 1x atlas path.
The existing F11 responsive fit chooses local font scale from width and 480px height rather than treating all 600px of virtual content as a strict non-scrolling visible viewport.
ImGui BeginChild ##tabbody scrolls overflowing options and the already-owned D3D9 external overlay stays within its existing per-eye VR render semantics.
alternatives_rejected: Do not globally enlarge the ImGui font atlas or mutate game HUD plane scale to address external F11 readability.
Do not claim HMD appearance correct from the static Quest3-resolution case; real Quest3/VDXR launch and menu interaction remain untested.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: The modification affects only glyph/control density before the external ImGui draw; existing ScreenOverlay2D semantic tagging and R84 stereo eye composition are unchanged.
